observations.text: Call is here what God is not ashamed of; it names the object of his attitude toward his people, not an inner operation of its own.
Call, in a naming, voices the inner state of the one who names, stated in the verse (grief, hope, thanks, trust or confession): the name is a purposeful act of the heart made audible.
Call is here the outward act of Jesus naming the disciples friends; it bears on their standing and not on an inner operation of the speaker.
Called, in a naming, voices the inner state of the one who names, stated in the verse (grief, hope, thanks, trust or confession): the name is a purposeful act of the heart made audible.
Called, negated, gives a disclaimed standing: the person judges himself unworthy to be called so, a humility of the heart.
observations.gives: standing disclaimed: the sense of unworthiness

observations.text: Called is here what God is not ashamed of; it names the object of his attitude toward his people, not an inner operation of its own.
Called is here the designation a person refuses by faith: the refusal is a choice of the heart.
